Can I change the shipping address on an order I just placed?
Yes — the shipping address can be updated until the shipping label has been created. Orders process quickly, so the best chance is to request the change as soon as possible.
If your order does not have a tracking number yet, contact customer care to request the change. If you email, include your order number and the new address. Do not reply to order confirmation or status emails, because those go to a no-reply inbox.
Important limits:
- The address cannot be changed to an international location, a PO Box, or a state outside the 48 contiguous United States.
- If the order already has a tracking number, K9 Ballistics can submit an address change request with FedEx, and FedEx charges a $17 fee for address corrections.
- FedEx does not guarantee the change will succeed.
- If the package is already out for delivery, it cannot be changed.

Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?
K9 Ballistics • AI Assistant
There is no guaranteed cancellation window after placing an order. K9 Ballistics processes orders quickly, so they will do their best to cancel it if you contact them right away, but they cannot guarantee a successful cancellation.
What determines eligibility:
- If the order has not been packed for shipment yet, it may be canceled.
- If you have already received a tracking number, it cannot be canceled.
- If the order has already been packed and shipped, it cannot be canceled.
- Personalized items cannot be canceled once placed because they cannot be restocked.

What happens if it already shipped, can it still be changed?
If the order has already shipped, it cannot be canceled and no item changes can be made.
For a shipping address after shipment:
- K9 Ballistics can only ask the carrier to try to update it while the package is in transit.
- For FedEx shipments, an address correction request has a $17 fee.
- The carrier does not guarantee the address change will succeed.
